notJoined.title: Open the link from your church
notJoined.body: On the church computer, open Settings > Phones > Join with a link, then scan the code or open the link on this device.

removed.title: This device was removed
removed.body: The church took back this device's access. Ask for a new link to join again.

invalid.title: This is not a Church Hub link
invalid.body: Check that the whole link was copied, or scan the code again.

refused.title: This link no longer works
refused.body: It was revoked. Ask for a new link.

offline.title: Could not reach Church Hub Cloud
offline.body: Check the internet connection and try again.

leave.title: Leave this church?
leave.message: This device will need a new link to join again.

songs.empty: The church has no songs yet.
songs.loadFailed: Could not load the songs. Check the internet connection.
